narrative.northStar: สมุดนัดทริป (Journey Notebook)
narrative.overview: A clear, friendly place where friends settle a plan together. The current decision leads; setup and management remain nearby without competing for attention.

rules.name: Decision First
rules.body: Place the current plan or vote result before setup and administrative controls.

rules.name: State in Words
rules.body: Availability and attendance always use labels as well as color.

dos: Place the current plan or vote result before setup and administrative controls.
Show response counts, outstanding friends, and individual states together.
donts: Use a stack of identical cards where a list or table is clearer.
Rely on color alone to explain attendance or availability.
